collection_notes: Unopposed. Not the incumbent of At-Large Position 2 (held by Shawn Looney); she is an appointed associate director. WMSWCD board page lists Zone 5 Terri Preeg Riggsby (Chair, term ends Dec 2026), Zone 4 Vacant, At Large Position 2 Shawn Looney (term ends Dec 2026), and Ronda Zakocs as an appointed Associate Director (2026-present).
